newsitem.title: FINLAND: MASSIVE IN-HOUSE DEAL IN ASKO.
newsitem.headline: MASSIVE IN-HOUSE DEAL IN ASKO.

text.p: Trade in Finnish plastic pipe and furniture group Asko Oy was boosted by a massive in-house deal on Thursday.
At 1310/1010 GMT, Asko traded at 250.00 markka, up 5.00 markka or about two percent. The share earlier hit a two-year high 253.00 markka.
Alfred Berg Securities traded 423,000 shares at 250.00 markka per share in-house. The value of the deal was almost 106 million markka.
Alfred Berg declined to comment on the transaction.
At Asko, an executive declined comment. Asko has slightly more than seven million shares.
